items.question: What is the first step in an export strategy?
items.answer: An honest export readiness assessment. Check production capacity, finances and people before market research. Marketing cannot fix operations that are not ready.

items.question: What is the most important change after Brexit?
items.answer: UKCA marking replacing CE for many products, plus new customs procedures. Review standards and certification, and plan stock around longer customs times.

items.question: Why does localisation matter so much?
items.answer: It makes you an adopted brand, not a foreign one. Packaging, colours, payment methods and service tone all need to fit British habits.

items.question: What is the most common mistake Turkish SMEs make?
items.answer: Trying to sell everywhere, on price alone. It wastes budget and turns the brand into a commodity.

items.question: When do Turquality and government incentives fit in?
items.answer: After the strategy is set. They finance the plan, they are not the plan. Choose the market and product first, then the fair, promotion or brand registration support that fits.
